name: EVOCOM
recent: Evocom 于 2026 年 9 月 28 日在 ACE 市场上市，IPO 发行价为 RM0.18，但首日股价下跌超过 28%。公司随后在 11 月公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度的业绩，受上市费用影响，净利润同比大幅下降。近期董事及主要股东出现股权变动，并有董事在闭市期前表示有意交易公司证券。
notable: 公司于 2026 年 9 月 28 日在 ACE 市场上市，IPO 发行价为 RM0.18，首日股价下跌超过 28%。
公司公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度业绩，净利润同比下降 78% 至 RM166,000，主要受上市费用影响。
董事 Dr Esther Loo Chee Hong 于 2026 年 9 月 28 日通过场外交易增持 100,000 股。
risks: 公司上市首日股价较 IPO 发行价下跌超过 28%。
董事及主要股东近期出现股权变动，且董事在闭市期前表示有意交易公司证券。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度，公司营收为 RM42,827,000，环比增长 3.5%；净利润为 RM759,000，环比下降 2.4%，净利率为 1.8%。

recent_en: Evocom listed on the ACE Market on 28 September 2026 at an IPO price of RM0.18 but fell over 28% on its debut. The company later announced quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 in November, with net profit declining sharply year-on-year due to listing expenses. There were recent changes in directors' and substantial shareholders' interests, and a director indicated intention to trade the company's securities ahead of the closed period.
notable_en: The company listed on the ACE Market on 28 September 2026 at an IPO price of RM0.18, with shares falling over 28% on the first day.
The company announced quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026, with net profit down 78% year-on-year to RM166,000, mainly due to listing expenses.
Director Dr Esther Loo Chee Hong acquired 100,000 shares through off-market transactions on 28 September 2026.
risks_en: The share price fell over 28% from the IPO price on the first trading day.
There were recent changes in directors' and substantial shareholders' interests, and a director indicated intention to trade the company's securities ahead of the closed period.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM42,827,000, up 3.5% quarter-on-quarter; net profit was RM759,000, down 2.4% quarter-on-quarter, with a net margin of 1.8%.
